name: AcceptReconciliationProposal
transaction_boundary: one short outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork shared with exactly one owning-domain mutation service and required participants
guards: recovery run has latest exact authorized review

for sr_source_disappearance_review: current LLD-03 source_presence_base_token equals proposal base_state_token_sha256 and SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider validates the exact proposal/import_run/prior_source_observation/target SR population-absence evidence
proposal kind resolves to one static owner service
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binding proposal id/revision/fingerprint/base token and material reason
receipt_order: authoritative revalidation/no-change -> insert one receipt -> owner/participant writes -> LLD-04 disposition/proposal/counter writes -> audits/results -> commit
mutations: exact LLD-03 or LLD-05 owner writes; LLD-02/06 only through declared participants
disappearance_acceptance: sr_source_disappearance_review dispatches only to LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService.apply_source_disappearance_review after the exact presence-token/provider guards. After the one outer receipt exists, the owner appends one disappearance_reviewed event and its registered LLD-03 audit/result evidence; then LLD-04 records the accepted disposition/run counters in the same UoW. Reject/Defer/Supersede append no LLD-03 warning event. Any owner/provider failure rolls back the receipt/event/audit/result and leaves no accepted disposition.
revision_effects: proposal/run increment exactly once when changed; owner revisions follow owner contract; source-presence event append does not fabricate an SR entity revision or source-field projection revision; NO_CHANGE increments none
post_commit_work: refresh projections only; RFC terminal cascade and Objective regrouping remain separate workflows. Source reappearance is not an acceptance follow-up: later successful Advanced Search publication schedules its own bounded durable reconciliation job.
